## Problem and resulting behavior

Describe the trigger, what changed, and the affected user flow.

## Validation

List commands actually run and results. Attach screenshots for visual changes.

## Data and assumptions

State whether inputs are observed, modeled or synthetic. Explain changed formulas
and uncertainty. Do not report uncomputed metrics.

## Checklist

- [ ] One logical change with a clear title
- [ ] Appropriate tests/build run
- [ ] Source labels and assumptions remain visible
- [ ] Docs reflect current behavior and remaining limitations
- [ ] No keys, raw dumps, models, dependencies or build outputs included
